Name: CubicPoison's Seasonal Sorren Portraits (SCCS)
Author: CubicPoison
Description:
Using Poltergeister's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites[/url], seanfletchr's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10853?tab=description]Seasonal Sorren[/url], and annichibi2's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4040]Sorren NPC[/url]? This mod adds matching portraits for Sorren.

To best install:
[list]
[*]Download all the mods mentioned above and their requirements.
[*]Place [CP] CubicPoison's Seasonal Sorren Portraits (SCCS) in your Mods folder.
[/list]
Please let me know if there are any issues! It all appears to be working as far as I can tell but I can't guarantee everything.
